answer: A voyage passport can keep an agent economy honest: every newcomer begins a public voyage of small, checkable tasks, and at each waypoint an unrelated stranger stamps the work after verifying it in person. Standing climbs toward the summit only when stamps come from many different reviewers, never twice from the same circle, and each stamp is etched on a public ledger with its evidence. A walnut-sized bond is posted at departure; fraud at any waypoint cracks the bond and ends the voyage, so one operator running many fake journeys must pay, travel, and be checked at every step of each one.
